note: Draft from SDK files and read-only reads on probe M3010001, 2026-10-14. Not wired into the page. Fields follow site/flash/bench/board.json.

usb.note: same XDS110 CMSIS-DAP interface as the MSPM0 board; product ID not re-read here

identity.note: 0x41C40000 (the MSPM0 address) reads 0 on this chip

flash.controllerAddress: CMDADDR is the offset from 0; bank 1 starts at 0x80000
flash.externalFlash: 8 MB QSPI holds the OLED demo and is not reachable by the debugger

semaphore.rule: request before any flash register is readable or writable; release after

protectAtRest.note: all read 0 without the semaphore. Clear status does NOT re-protect; the proof wrote the at-rest values back by hand

controller.sequence: halt; request semaphore and check 0xC0010101; clear status; CMDWEPROTA=CMDWEPROTB=0; CMDTYPE; CMDADDR; (program: CMDBYTEN, CMDDATAINDEX=(addr>>4)&3, CMDDATA0..3); CMDEXEC=1; poll STATCMD for done and pass; at the end restore WEPROT, release semaphore

neverWrite.name: mass erase and factory reset
neverWrite.why: DL_FlashCTL_massErase*/factoryReset* touch data flash and NONMAIN

gpio.note: DOE read 0x4 on port A and 0x0C000000 on port C with TI's shipped program running; polarity not checked

cache.register: none found in the SDK headers
cache.note: readback after a write matched without turning anything off

hardwareResults.save: 1,048,576 bytes read three times, sha256 33d3bdbfec7f6ca3ba56416f99e02300ec4b6aa09f116db99da2fe9cb3e51968 every time
hardwareResults.proof: sector 0xFF800 (last 2 KB of bank 1, blank before): erased, 128 words of a pattern programmed, read back with 0 mismatches, erased again; flash afterwards byte for byte equal to the first save. Write protection put back to its at-rest values by hand
hardwareResults.factoryRead: TRACEID 0x008080FC, DEVICEID 0x0BBB702F, USERID 0x801043B6; same through 0x80111000 and 0x90111000
